# Paired mbox locking reviews retain incomplete coverage and owned-result reasoning

The first review retained a Not Done concern about lock coverage. Ben Campbell described the change as incomplete. The author preferred landing it with the additional-locking patch. A report that one ThreadSanitizer issue disappeared does not establish that all races were removed.

In the paired review, the author copied the PumpData result before releasing the lock. MsgOffset protection was requested and marked Done. The Glean telemetry helper was removed after a reviewer gave a scoped assurance; moving it to a free function remained an alternative. Calling the raw stream while holding the lock began as an author assumption, not a proof that deadlock was impossible. Link the existing source lessons for the actual locking and result ownership behavior.
